#47

त्वदन्येन|tvad anyena|tvad — you (compound stem form of tvam, used in compounds, 'other than you');;anya — other (anyena: instr. sg. masc., agreeing with an unexpressed agent, 'by one other than you'; tvat + anyena: -t + a- → -d a-, voicing before a vowel)
